{{Quote|The enemy has a camp in the valley nearby. My scouts say the Flesh Raiders store their weapons and other tech in a cave.|Scout Chief Moorint|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the native [[Flesh Raider]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] began to attack the world's other inhabitants, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and a group of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]], in greater numbers. In [[3643 BBY]], as part of the Order's attempt to quell the natives' [[Flesh Raider uprising|uprising]], the [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] '''raided''' a weapons cache belonging to the Flesh Raiders in the [[Upper Hollows]] of the [[Tythos Ridge]]. Fighting through the Flesh Raider forces, the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] recovered the natives' [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and rescued an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] by the name of [[T7-O1]] after defeating the native's [[Unidentified Flesh Raider Warmaster|warmaster]]. Upon returning to the Twi'lek settlement of [[Kalikori village]], the Padawan gave the weapons to [[Ranna Tao'Ven]], the daughter of the village's [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]], and the other Pilgrims so they could better defend themselves.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|My scouts have tracked the Flesh Raiders for months. Watched them grow in strength. I will share what we've discovered, but only if you agree to protect my people. We&hellip; we suffer&hellip;|Matriarch Sumari|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> after defeating the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Callef]] and halting an invasion of the area of the planet known as the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] by the native [[Flesh Raider]]s, a young [[Hero of Tython|Jedi apprentice]] was ordered to the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]]. There, the learner came before the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] and was taken on by Din as an official [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

When the Council decided to investigate Callef and the natives' recent [[Flesh Raider uprising|uprising]], Orgus Din gave his apprentice an assignment. The Padawan's first mission was to journey to the nearby [[Kalikori village]], an illegal settlement of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]], and find out what the settlers knew about the shadowy influence behind the Flesh Raiders' increased attacks. There, the Padawan met with [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Sumari]], the village's leader, and learned that the Flesh Raider attacks had been increasing in the area as well. When the Matriarch was forced to retire out of illness, her daughter [[Ranna Tao'Ven]] and the village's [[Scout/Legends|Scout Chief]] [[Moorint]] took over the conversation.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

==The raid==
{{GameLS}}
{{Quote|Find the Flesh Raider technology and do what you think is best. Good luck, Master Jedi.|Ranna Tao'Ven|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
Moorint's scouts had learned of a Flesh Raider weapons cache in the [[Upper Hollows]] region of the nearby [[Tythos Ridge]], and he asked the Padawan to destroy the weapons in order to deny the natives a tactical and technological advantage. However, Tao'Ven disagreed, believing that the weapons would be more useful if the Padawan recovered them for the villagers. Thinking over the matter, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] agreed with Tao'Ven and decided to retrieve the weapons.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

[[File:Weapons_cache.png|thumb|left|220px|The weapons cache]]
Moorint warned the Jedi, however, that an access key from one of the Flesh Raiders' leaders would be required to enter the cache. Fighting through the Flesh Raiders along the mountain path, the Padawan ascended into the mountains and entered the cave system known as the Upper Hollows. Using only a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]], the young Jedi fought past at least nine Flesh Raiders and a [[Manka cat/Legends|manka cat]] before facing the [[Unidentified Flesh Raider Warmaster|natives' Warmaster]]. Despite the Flesh Raider's size and brute strength, the Padawan was able to defeat the native and claim the access key.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

Inside, the Jedi found a supply of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other weapons, and recovered them for the village. However, the Padawan also found an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[T7-O1]], who revealed that he had been working as a survey droid for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] when he was captured by the Flesh Raiders. T7 also showed the Padawan a [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecording]] that the droid had taken while faking deactivation, which revealed that a [[Bengel Morr|hooded figure]]&mdash;Callef's master&mdash;had ordered the Dark Jedi to attack the Gnarls. After the Padawan removed T7's faulty [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]], the pair brought the weapons back to Kalikori Village and gave them to Tao'Ven and Moorint.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|She died in my arms. You should've seen what those filth did to her.''"<br />"''I'm sorry, Saylew. We all share your loss.''"<br />"''For every one of us the Flesh Raiders butcher, we should kill ten! No, a thousand!|Saylew rages at Ranna Tao'Ven|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
The Padawan was surprised to see that Orgus Din had also arrived at the village, but interrupted an argument between Tao'Ven, Moorint, Din, and a villager named [[Saylew]]. While the Padawan had been recovering the weapons, the Flesh Raiders had attacked the village and [[Saylew's wife]] had been killed. After the argument ended with Saylew storming off in disappointment, the apprentice wasted no time in showing T7's recording to the Jedi Master. Troubled, Din refused to answer his apprentice's questions about the identity of the figure, and took the droid back to the Temple with him,<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> though not before giving the Padawan a new mission: investigate the recent sightings of Flesh Raiders near the ancient ruins of [[Kaleth]], a temple of the Jedi Order's [[Je'daii Order|precursors]].<ref name="Enemy Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Sabotage would thin the Flesh Raider numbers and eliminate their technological advantage.''"<br />"''If you brought that technology here, we could defend ourselves with those weapons.|Moorint and Ranna Tao'Ven, presenting the dark and light side options to the player|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
The raid on the Flesh Raiders weapons cache appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The events of the raid occur in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class story mission "High-Tech Savages," part of the character's storyline on Tython. For dark-side points, the player may choose to destroy the weapons and deprive the village of the tactical advantage, or they can choose to recover the weapons for light-side points. Also, players can choose to remove T7's restraining bolt for light-side points, or refuse and have Orgus Din remove it later for dark-side points. As the Jedi Knight is a Republic character, it is assumed that they choose only light-side options.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />
